FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
 recipe : ARRAY[1..8] OF ST_Recipe;
 selSlot : INT;
 loadCmd : BOOL;
 running : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
 valid : BOOL;
 loadedID : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
 prevLoadCmd : BOOL;
 tmp_edge : BOOL;
 tmp_slot : INT;
END_VAR

tmp_edge := loadCmd AND NOT prevLoadCmd;
prevLoadCmd := loadCmd;

IF tmp_edge AND NOT running THEN
    tmp_slot := selSlot;
    IF tmp_slot >= 1 AND tmp_slot <= 8 THEN
        IF recipe[tmp_slot].recipeID <> 0
           AND recipe[tmp_slot].totalRatio >= 99.0
           AND recipe[tmp_slot].totalRatio <= 101.0
           AND recipe[tmp_slot].temperature >= 30.0
           AND recipe[tmp_slot].temperature <= 180.0 THEN
            valid := TRUE;
            loadedID := recipe[tmp_slot].recipeID;
        ELSE
            valid := FALSE;
            loadedID := 0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        valid := FALSE;
        loadedID := 0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
